scope: Separately declared refined-Euler training capacity experiment; no held-out selection or new dynamics.
optimizer: Adam with freshly initialized moments in both runs; not exact resume
primary_comparison: Final training MSE at 200 additional updates and finite completion; unchanged 90% capacity gate.
secondary_comparison: Best saved MSE; independent replay, half-step and preparation/drift controls. Compare with original dt=0.01 run only over finite iterates; it has no final-200 result.
capacity_gate: unchanged: final capture of at least 90% of zero-start mean-response energy
